name: CHT Security Co., Ltd.
summary: CHT Security Co., Ltd. provides telco-centric network security and cyber security services in Taiwan. The company offers security assessment services comprising source code security analysis, vulnerability assessment, web personal data scanning, penetration testing, cyber security evaluation, social engineering assessment, AI application testing, mobile app security assessment, red teaming, financial security assessment, IoT testing, drone testing, DDoS simulation, and OT security; and managed security and consulting services consisting of security operation center, CERT and digital forensics, managed detection and response, website defacement monitoring, public key infrastructure, and ISMS …
